first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A distant short-haired man wearing a dark gray suit jacket, white shirt, and dark tie, with an arm extended toward Person B.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: A man in the foreground wearing a long black coat and with short dark hair, with their back or side-back toward the viewpoint, leaning backward in a low position and adjusting both arms, with the coat hem curling up.

entities.name: glass-curtain-wall high-rise
entities.identification: A high-rise in the background with a blue-gray reflective facade, light-colored vertical columns, and rectangular window panes.

entities.name: aircraft A
entities.identification: The portion of aircraft A revealed from the left in the latter part, with a dark gray curved underside and tubular skid landing gear.

entities.name: rooftop surface
entities.identification: A gray-brown, flat, broad rooftop surface with straight seams running lengthwise and crosswise.

entities.name: low rooftop wall
entities.identification: A light gray-beige low wall extending along the rooftop edge, with a corner and sloped supports visible.

entities.name: rooftop metal railing
entities.identification: A railing along the right edge of the rooftop, composed of thin gray horizontal bars and spaced vertical bars.

entities.name: distant city buildings
entities.identification: The group of background buildings exposed to the right of the glass-curtain-wall high-rise; in this clip, mainly a portion of one light gray-brown building is discernible.

entities.name: translucent ring-shaped disturbance
entities.identification: Light gray translucent rings near the left side of the image at the beginning, arranged nearly horizontally and gradually becoming smaller into the depth of the scene.

entities.name: sky
entities.identification: The bright, hazy, light gray-blue sky outside the buildings, without clearly defined cloud boundaries.
